# ProsperitySMP

> ProsperitySMP · Java `play.prosperitysmp.com` · Bedrock `15.204.249.228:19132` · Paper 1.21.8 · Java + Bedrock crossplay via Geyser · Season 0, live · Open to public, no whitelist

A Minecraft survival economy server. Six jobs (Miner, Farmer, Builder, Woodcutter, Hunter, Fisherman) with three free job slots, chest shops run by players, land that runs out, rent due weekly, and a public contract board. Java and Bedrock players share one world, one economy and one chat. The resource world is unprotected and keep-inventory is off there. The Central Bank is open: flexible savings (`/savings`), 7-day bonds (`/bond`) and the Prosperity Index (`/stocks`) are all live. The weekend boost is 1.5x. There is no referral programme.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.prosperitysmp.com/): both IPs, the six jobs, and the four things to do first.
- [Getting started](https://www.prosperitysmp.com/getting-started): how to connect on Java and Bedrock, then the first 30 minutes.
- [FAQ](https://www.prosperitysmp.com/faq): joining, crossplay, jobs, land, and what is not live yet.
- [Useful commands](https://www.prosperitysmp.com/commands): the command reference, with disabled commands marked as such.
- [Economy guide](https://www.prosperitysmp.com/economy): income sources, money sinks, shop prices, prestige.
- [Skill trees and jobs](https://www.prosperitysmp.com/skill-trees): the six job trees, job slots, prestige costs and bonuses.
- [Contracts](https://www.prosperitysmp.com/contracts): civic supply contracts and government build contracts.
- [Laws and fines](https://www.prosperitysmp.com/laws): offences, the fine schedule, jail, appeals, reporting.
- [Changelog](https://www.prosperitysmp.com/changelog): dated update history, including corrections and retractions.
